verdict.rationale: Workspace administration is a fair axis for a team-facing ChatGPT agent product, and an enterprise docs page exists, but the evidence never shows an admin managing members, org-wide permissions, or data policies. The cited controls are per-user: action rules for one's own dot and inherited personal ChatGPT app permissions. The enterprise page's mention of 'permitted local repositories' only implies that some permitting exists, without documenting any admin console or policy management.
